envelope.description: A typed message clears the queue (denying in-turn requests first)

body.title: A typed message clears the queue (denying in-turn requests first)
body.summary: On a user-typed submit-turn (not a follow-up), before the turn starts: answer every undecided in-turn request whose turn is still live with decide(live.turnId, requestId, 'deny'); then record each undecided request as rejected, clear the queue and reset the grant chain; then run the user's message as a normal turn.
acceptanceChecks: With a queued in-turn request, a typed message calls decide(turnId, requestId, 'deny') before the new turn starts
Every undecided request gets a rejected chip and the queue is empty
The next approval follow-up does not carry grants from before the typed message

tests.name: a user-typed message while requests are queued records each as rejected, clears the queue, resets the grant chain and runs as a normal turn
a live provider with a queued in-turn request, then the user types a message: decide(turnId, requestId, 'deny') is called before the new turn starts, and the request gets a rejected chip
